what: Alliant Energy is a regulated utility serving Iowa and Wisconsin. It generates and delivers electricity and distributes natural gas to about 1.5 million customers.
customers: Households, businesses, farms and a growing number of data centres across Iowa and Wisconsin.
money: regulated electricity and gas in Iowa
regulated electricity and gas in Wisconsin
moat: Regulated monopolies in two Midwestern states, with returns set by state commissions and demand that holds through economic cycles.
risks: Debt of about $11 billion against almost no cash
Return on invested capital of about 4% is low, as is normal for a regulated utility
Large data centre customers concentrate demand with a few counterparties
opportunities: Revenue grew about 10% last year with a 24% operating margin
Large data centre projects in Iowa and Wisconsin raise projected load growth sharply
A dividend yield around 3% with consistent increases
watch: Data centre load commitments and rate case outcomes.
